translations.lab.title: Design Lab
translations.lab.intro: "Two Voices", the whole system on one page. Development builds only. Every name, number and message here is sample content, written for this page.
translations.lab.colour.note: Values are read live from the page, so they are the ones this theme actually resolved. Lagoon means the AI and Ember means a person; neither is ever decoration or status.
translations.lab.colour.sideBySide: Voice and status, side by side
translations.lab.colour.sideBySide.note: Ember (a person) is orange, warning is a yellow amber, danger is crimson. Each carries its own glyph and word, so none depends on its hue.
translations.lab.type.note: Instrument Sans (headings narrowed to 86%) and IBM Plex Sans Arabic, both self-hosted. Figures are tabular and stay Western in both languages.
translations.lab.shape.card: A card: a hairline, no shadow.
translations.lab.shape.overlay: An overlay: the only thing that casts a shadow.
translations.lab.icons.note: One authored 24px outline set, 1.6 stroke with round joins. Channel glyphs are generic and always shown with the channel's name; no brand logo is recoloured. Arrows and chevrons turn round in a right-to-left page.
translations.lab.mark.note: Two speech shapes overlapping into an "O". Never mirrored.
translations.lab.buttons.note: Hover, press and focus are live: point at them, or press Tab.
translations.lab.forms.agentName.hint: Shown to customers as the sender of AI replies.
translations.lab.forms.greeting.placeholder: For example: Hi, how can I help?
translations.lab.forms.address.error: Use lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.
translations.lab.content.card.subtitle: A grouping device, not a default wrapper.
translations.lab.content.card.body: Cards are white on the porcelain page, edged by a hairline.
translations.lab.content.menu.label: Sample menu
translations.lab.feedback.info: Sample: indexing runs in the background.
translations.lab.feedback.warning: Sample: the plan's message limit is close.
translations.lab.feedback.danger: Sample: the document could not be read.
translations.lab.feedback.stale.title: Sample: someone else changed this agent
translations.lab.feedback.stale.body: Your edits are still here. Review the newer version, or keep yours.
translations.lab.dialog.handBack.heading: Sample: hand this conversation back to the AI?
translations.lab.dialog.handBack.body: The AI answers the next customer message. You can take it over again at any time.
translations.lab.dialog.delete.heading: Sample: delete this document?
translations.lab.dialog.delete.body: Agents stop using it at once. This cannot be undone.
translations.lab.empty.heading: Sample: no conversations yet
translations.lab.empty.description: They appear here as soon as a customer writes on a connected channel.
translations.lab.error.heading: Sample: this list could not be loaded
translations.lab.error.description: Nothing was changed. Check the connection and try again.
translations.lab.voices.takeOver.note: The same chip changes voice: a 320ms sweep on the emphasized curve, instant under reduced motion.
translations.lab.voices.track: Voice track (from the sample transcript below)
